walk.en: I waddle side to side, and I walk steady.
Dry ground does not suit my gait.
I take one step at a time, like an inspection.
My wings are spread, so clear the way.
I walk the waterline and do not stray.
My webbed feet slap the stone, pat pat.
I walk slowly out of contempt, not weakness.
The mud ahead, I step straight through it.
I skirt the puddles to stay clean.
Whoever walks ahead of me, step aside.
Chest out, head high, I go forward.
I will walk this patch first, to claim it.

walk.zh: 我的影子抢先到了岸边。
walk.en: My shadow reaches the bank before I do.

walk.zh: 回头看一眼，确认没人跟。
walk.en: One look back to be sure no one follows.

idle.en: I smooth the white feathers on my chest.
This stretch of water has only me.

idle.zh: 我盯着倒影，越看越满意。
idle.en: I study my reflection and approve of it.
One call from me and the birds scatter.
I am counting my own merits.
The ripples shift and I frown at them.
That one earlier was not fit to walk with me.
I fold my wings behind my back.
Quiet is something only the strong can keep.
I am waiting for a fish worth my time.
This surface is mine; do not disturb it.

look_player.en: You stand downstream of me; that is acceptable.
What are you looking at? Never seen a penguin?
I do not need your appraisal.
Your shoes are muddy from the bank.
Chin up, I grant you one glance.
Do not come closer; keep your distance.
What exactly would you compare with me?
I doubt you could catch me.
The moment you speak, I want to leave.
I turn my back on you.

look_player.zh: 你的影子别落到我身上。

look_player.en: One glance from me is enough.
I do not stand shoulder to shoulder with anyone.

tempted.en: Offering fish means you want to buy me.
I condescend to take one step closer.
I know a fishing line when I see one.
This one is not fat enough; bring another.
Stop swaying; the fish will bolt.
I will look at it first, not eat it.
One splash and I am already over there.
I am not greedy; I am particular.
The one in your hand is barely acceptable.

collide.en: You bumped me and wet my feathers.
Back off; do not walk against me.

collide.zh: 我的翅膀被你压了一下。
collide.en: You pressed down on my wing.

collide.zh: 我抖了抖身子，甩你一身水。
collide.en: I shake myself and splash you.
If you slip, that is your problem.
Once more and I will not be polite.

mate.en: I permit you to stand beside me.

mate.zh: 这不是群，只是我们两个。
mate.en: This is not a flock, only the two of us.
Would you listen if I sang?

mate.zh: 我嗓子一般，但只唱给你。
mate.en: My voice is plain, but it is only for you.

mate.zh: 你别学我走路，太难看了。
mate.en: Do not copy my walk; you look absurd.

mate.zh: 我把最好的那块鱼留给你。
mate.en: I saved the best piece of fish for you.

mate.zh: 别走太远，我看得见就行。
mate.en: Do not go far; just stay in my sight.
I do not say soft things; understand it anyway.

mate.zh: 水边这块石头，够我们坐。
mate.en: This stone by the water seats us both.

mate.zh: 你是第一个我不赶走的。
mate.en: You are the first I have not driven off.

pickup.en: I take it in my beak and look.
It fell in the water, and I fished it out.
It is mine; do not argue.
It is slick and nearly slipped away.
I pin it under my webbed foot.
Useless thing, so I drop it.
This one can go into my nest.
I carried it in my beak a while.
Someone dropped it; I will hold it for now.

target_acquire.en: You stepped into my stretch of water.
No need to talk; let us fight.
My wings spread, and that is a declaration.
One opponent is all I need.
I intend to prove I am stronger.
The water where you stand is mine.
I have fixed on you; do not think of running.
I call no help and need none.

target_acquire.zh: 来吧，我的翅膀已经张开。
target_acquire.en: Come on; my wings are already open.

targeting.en: I lower my weight, ready to charge.
You retreat to the water, which suits me.
I have the distance measured: three steps.

targeting.zh: 你的动作太慢，我看得清。
targeting.en: You move slowly enough for me to read.
I stand still and let you come first.

targeting.zh: 水面是我的退路，你没有。
targeting.en: The water is my escape, not yours.
Water starts gathering in my throat.
Keep watching; I move any moment now.
This blow, I will not hold back.

melee_attack.en: I crack a wing across your shoulder.
A jet of water shoots from my beak.
I charge and ram your chest.
That one should make you remember me.
I jab your wrist with my beak.
The spray covers you and I slip back.
My form is ugly, but the hit is heavy.
You fall back, so I have won half a move.
I shake the water off my wings.
Hit me again; my legs still hold.

spawn.en: I climb out of the water, soaked.
This bank is narrower than I expected.
First I shake off, then look around.
No one has claimed this stretch before me.

spawn.zh: 我站直，摆出最好的角度。
spawn.en: I stand tall at my best angle.
Weeds are caught around my feet.
The wind up here is too dry.
I flap once and droplets scatter.
Only after I leave does the water calm.
I check the sky and judge the wind.
I call once to announce my arrival.

generic.en: I have written that blow in my ledger.
I gave half a step, but did not fall.
It hurts, yet I make no sound.
My wing droops, then lifts again.
That is not a wound, only dirt.
I bite down and swallow the water back.
My white feathers are smeared with mud.
I take one breath and set my feet.
You hit hard, but not hard enough.

fall.en: I land on the bank, badly.

drown.en: I choked on a mouthful of water.

explosion.en: My ears are full of ringing.

projectile.en: Something is lodged in my wing.

starvation.en: Too long hungry, and I can barely swim.

void.en: There is no water here, and no bank.
